name: Japan
shortSummary: India and Japan share a "Special Strategic and Global Partnership," anchored by large-scale Japanese development financing, the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project, and close QUAD coordination.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Japan is among India's largest bilateral development-loan providers, funding metro, freight corridor and rail projects.
Joint initiatives on semiconductor supply chains and critical minerals.

majorChallenges.title: Bullet train project delays
majorChallenges.description: Land acquisition and implementation delays have pushed back the flagship high-speed rail timeline.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued QUAD and Act East Forum coordination
recentDevelopments.description: India and Japan sustained close coordination through the QUAD grouping and the Act East Forum on northeastern India infrastructure projects.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reinforces one of India's most stable and deeply institutionalized major-power partnerships.

recentDevelopments.title: Bullet train project progresses amid continued delays
recentDevelopments.description: Construction on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor continued, though land acquisition issues kept the project behind its original timeline.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: The flagship infrastructure project remains a visible, if delayed, symbol of the deepening economic partnership.

historicalEvents.title: Global Partnership between India and Japan
historicalEvents.description: India and Japan elevate ties to a Global Partnership during PM Yoshiro Mori's visit.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic and Global Partnership
historicalEvents.description: Relations are further upgraded during PM Manmohan Singh's visit to Tokyo.

historicalEvents.title: Special Strategic and Global Partnership
historicalEvents.description: Ties are elevated again, with Japan committing a low-interest loan for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (bullet train) project.

historicalEvents.title: Act East Forum
historicalEvents.description: India and Japan launch a forum to coordinate infrastructure development in India's northeastern states.

agreements.name: India-Japan Civil Nuclear Agreement
agreements.description: Agreement enabling civil nuclear cooperation despite India being outside the NPT.

agreements.name: Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail financing
agreements.description: Japan International Cooperation Agency loan financing India's first bullet train corridor.

defenceCooperation.name: Malabar Exercise
defenceCooperation.description: Japan is a permanent participant alongside India, the US and Australia in this multilateral naval exercise.

defenceCooperation.name: Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA)
defenceCooperation.description: Reciprocal logistics support agreement between the Indian and Japanese armed forces.

trade.majorExports: Petroleum products, iron and steel, marine products
trade.majorImports: Machinery, electronics, iron and steel products

multilateralRelations.detail: Founding member alongside India, the US and Australia, focused on a free and open Indo-Pacific.
